messages:
Nina (PM): Quick heads-up: GovBank requires BYOK across hosted + private, immutable audit exports for 7 years, and SOC2-style export packages. They want acceptance criteria before signing.

Ruth (Sales): This is a top-priority deal and pricing sensitive. They want an API to request exports and a predictable archival price.

Omar (Sec): Key questions: do they need exports cryptographically tied to their KMS or is Redwood-signed evidence acceptable for contract start? Also, define immutability: append-only WORM vs tamper-evident manifests.

Lee (Eng): Tech approach (MVP): CMEK (tenant KMS) support + per-tenant retention config up to 7y; store daily compressed log chunks, keep wrapped DEKs per rotation epoch; export job bundles logs + manifest + Merkle root + Redwood signature. WORM store is a later enhancement.

Tess (Legal): For contracts: exports must include chain-of-custody (requester, approver, hashes, signer identity) and a turnaround SLA. 5 business days for standard exports is reasonable. Also need legal-hold pinning flow.

Nina (PM): Proposed launch acceptance criteria (MVP): 1) CMEK support for hosted + private, 2) per-tenant retention config (90d/2y/5y/7y), 3) exportable evidence package (logs + manifest + Merkle root + Redwood-signed attestation), 4) audit trail for export requests and legal-hold pinning, 5) pricing model for archival storage and export fees.

Ruth (Sales): We'll tier offering: hosted default up to 2y, enterprise add-on for 5-7y + expedited export option. I'll map affected deals.

Omar (Sec): Must include wrapped DEK epoch retention and docs explaining key rotation + how revocation affects past exports. I'll draft security design.

Lee (Eng): I'll prototype a parallel export runner and give a storage/cost estimate. Need infra ticket for cold storage SLA.

Tess (Legal): I'll draft SLA language and export artifact checklist (cover letter, algorithms, signer info).

ops-bot: Created ticket PROD-5100 "BYOK + 7yr archival export scoping" assigned to @Lee, @Omar, @Nina. Due in 7 days.

Nina (PM): Thanks all 12 let's reconvene after prototypes and SLA language. Ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
